subject: AWS Marketplace onboarding - SOC2 / pen test / DPA needed
messages:
From: amy.jenkins@amazon.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 evidence + DPA for AWS Marketplace co-sell listing

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — we're moving Redwood Inference through the AWS Marketplace co-sell intake and need to attach security/compliance evidence to the listing. Please provide the following by next Wednesday if possible:

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok) covering hosting and data processing controls
- Penetration test attestation or letter from your assessor (high level ok)
- Executed Data Processing Addendum (DPA) that we can reference on the listing

Also confirm whether the report covers multi-tenant hosted endpoints and any third-party subservice organizations (e.g., cloud provider). If you have a hosted evidence pack or an SSO link to a secure evidence room, that would speed review.

Can you confirm timeline and who from your side will own this?

Best,
Amy Jenkins
AWS Marketplace Partnerships
amy.jenkins@amazon.com

Attachments: none
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: amy.jenkins@amazon.com, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 evidence + DPA for AWS Marketplace co-sell listing

Amy — thanks for the list and the heads-up. We'll get this pulled together. Assigning owners:
- Vivek (security) will confirm scope and pull the SOC2 redacted PDF and pen test attestation.
- Connor (legal) will circulate the DPA redline and handle execution (DocuSign).
- Rachel (sales ops) will coordinate delivery and timeline with you and add the evidence to the AWS intake ticket.

Vivek — can you confirm whether the 2025 SOC2 Type II report includes our hosted inference endpoints (multi-tenant) and the cloud provider subservice orgs? If not, what supplemental attestation can we share?

Connor — please prepare a DPA variant suitable for marketplace listings; AWS typically requires an executed DPA attached to the listing. We've included the previous template in the evidence drive.

I'll follow up once we have the PDF stubs. Target internal turnaround: 48 business hours.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0117

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 evidence + DPA for AWS Marketplace co-sell listing

Marissa / team — attaching the redacted SOC2 and pen test attestation for marketplace intake. Quick notes:

- SOC2_TypeII_Redacted_2025.pdf: Type II period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Scope includes Redwood hosted inference service, API endpoints, key management processes, and backup/restore. We redacted customer-identifying artifacts and some network diagrams for public sharing.
- PenTest_Attestation_2025.pdf: High-level letter from the third-party assessor confirming an external network and web app pentest was performed in Aug 2025. The assessment includes our inference control plane and web console; the report itself is restricted, but the attestation letter is acceptable to most marketplaces.

Caveats: the SOC2 report covers our hosted cloud deployment (AWS us-west-2) and lists AWS as a subservice organization under section 3. If AWS requires deeper evidence around key rotation / KMS, we can extract control narratives but that will take more time.

Evidence repo: https://docs.google.com/drive/folders/1Redwood-Mktplace-Evidence (view-only link).

Attaching: SOC2_TypeII_Redacted_2025.pdf; PenTest_Attestation_2025.pdf

– Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Information Security
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Redacted_2025.pdf (PDF stub), PenTest_Attestation_2025.pdf (PDF stub)
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai

Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: DPA redline for AWS Marketplace listing (please review)

Amy / Amy's team — attaching a redline of our standard DPA for your review. Highlights of the redlines:
- Limited liability carveout specifically for marketplace listing metadata (we kept the standard security obligations).
- Clarified data retention and deletion timelines for trial accounts created via marketplace.
- Added reference to the SOC 2 attestation provided (see attached).

Request: please confirm whether the redline is acceptable or provide a short list of required edits. If it looks good, we can route the final DPA through DocuSign — link below.

DocuSign pre-fill: https://www.docusign.com/en/redwood-inference-aws-dpa-sign
Evidence folder (internal): https://docs.google.com/drive/folders/1Redwood-Mktplace-Evidence

Connor O'Brien (he/him)
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

Attachments: DPA_Redline_v3.docx (redline)
From: amy.jenkins@amazon.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: partners-security@aws-partners.amazon.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA redline for AWS Marketplace listing (please review)

Marissa / Connor — thanks for the fast turnaround and the evidence. I've shared the SOC2 redacted PDF with our security intake team and they raised two quick clarifying items:

1) Can you confirm the crypto/encryption controls for data at rest (KMS usage, CMKs vs AWS-managed keys)? A short control narrative is fine.
2) For the pen test attestation — did the scope include the inference public API (tokenized inference endpoints)? If yes, can you call that out in the attestation or provide a one-line confirmation in email?

Connor — the DPA redline looks reasonable from procurement's view. We'll need a signed copy for the listing; can you route via the DocuSign link? Once signed, I'll confirm final intake and update the marketplace listing.

If you can provide the two clarifications today, we should be able to complete intake next week.

Best,
Amy Jenkins
AWS Marketplace Partnerships
amy.jenkins@amazon.com
